audience.text: Developers who generate or modify PowerPoint presentations on a server or in a build pipeline and need a pure-Java, MIT-licensed dependency that operates entirely within the Office Open XML file format.

capabilities.text: The Presentation class serves as the root of the object model, supporting creation of new presentations and loading of existing .pptx files for modification.
capabilities.title: Create and edit presentations

capabilities.text: Developers can add AutoShapes, PictureFrames, Tables, and Connectors to slides, with support for 190 ShapeType values and comprehensive formatting options.
capabilities.title: Add and format shapes

capabilities.text: Shapes support eight visual effects including outer shadow, inner shadow, glow, soft edge, reflection, blur, preset shadow, and fill overlay via EffectFormat.
capabilities.title: Apply visual effects and 3D formatting

capabilities.text: Threaded comments support multiple authors with timestamps and positions, and speaker notes are managed per slide through NotesSlideManager.
capabilities.title: Manage threaded comments and speaker notes

capabilities.text: Text formatting is available at TextFrame, Paragraph, and Portion levels, and document properties including title, author, subject, keywords, and custom properties are supported.
capabilities.title: Format text and document properties

capabilities.text: Slides can be cloned, inserted, removed, and reordered through SlideCollection methods, with visibility control for slideshow purposes.
capabilities.title: Clone and manipulate slides

capabilities.text: Images are embedded from file, bytes, or InputStream via ImageCollection and attached to slides with PictureFrame, and tables can be created with custom cell content.
capabilities.title: Embed images and create tables

capabilities.text: Presentations can be saved to PPTX, PPSX, and POTX formats using the save() method with explicit path or stream and SaveFormat parameter.
capabilities.title: Save to multiple output formats

limitations.text: The library does not support charts, SmartArt, OLE objects, video, audio, animations, slide transitions, group shapes, hyperlinks, sections, slide backgrounds, themes, or slide size configuration.
Only three of the 25 declared SaveFormat values are supported: PPTX, PPSX, and POTX; all others raise UnsupportedOperationException.
Cloning a master slide via getMasters().addClone() has a known defect where the clone does not persist to the saved package despite the collection reporting a size increase.
Table.mergeCells() requires an XML-backed table and cannot merge cells on tables built without a backing OOXML element.
Text language attributes are not written to the package, so PowerPoint applies the authoring machine's default language instead of one specified in the file.
JDK 21 or later is required, and the library has no runtime dependencies beyond the JDK itself.

problems_solved.text: Enables server-side PowerPoint presentation generation and modification without requiring Microsoft Office, COM automation, or native code.
Preserves unknown XML content during round-trip operations, ensuring no content loss when loading and saving presentations.
Provides a secure XML parser that rejects DOCTYPE declarations and disables external entity resolution to prevent XXE vulnerabilities.
Supports building and testing with standard Java tooling including Maven and JUnit, with reproducible builds verified across platforms.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Slides FOSS for Java is a free, open-source, pure-Java library for creating, reading, and editing PowerPoint .pptx presentations without requiring Microsoft Office or any native dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact behavior of Table.mergeCells() on tables created without XML backing is not fully described beyond the limitation statement.
The specific XML parts that are preserved byte-for-byte during round-tripping versus those that are regenerated is measured on one specific deck but may vary for others.
The behavior of save() when called with an unsupported SaveFormat value beyond raising UnsupportedOperationException is not detailed beyond the refusal message.
The exact mechanism and limitations of the 'Relationship' symbol referenced in public_symbol are not described beyond its existence.

workflows.name: Create and save a new presentation
workflows.text: Developers instantiate a Presentation object, add shapes and content, then save to .pptx, .ppsx, or .potx formats using the save() method.

workflows.name: Open and modify existing presentations
workflows.text: Developers load existing .pptx files using the Presentation constructor with a file path, then modify slides, shapes, or properties and save the changes.

workflows.name: Add threaded comments and speaker notes
workflows.text: Developers add comment authors and threaded comments with timestamps and positions, and manage speaker notes per slide through NotesSlideManager.

workflows.name: Format text and shapes with effects
workflows.text: Developers apply solid, gradient, pattern, and picture fills to shapes, format text at portion level, and apply visual effects like outer shadow.

workflows.name: Build and test with Maven
workflows.text: Developers use Maven to install the dependency and run the full test suite including unit, integration, and conformance tests that verify the produced XML package structure.
